title: Chat Interface Endpoints
summary: This module provides various API endpoints for interacting with chat models, including basic chat, persona-steered chat, and gated chat. It offers both synchronous and streaming options for real-time interaction.

nodes.label: User API Request
nodes.title: User API Request
nodes.description: Represents an incoming request from a user or client application to one of the chat API endpoints.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Underlying Language Model
nodes.description: The core large language model responsible for generating text responses based on input prompts and various steering parameters.

nodes.label: Persona Steering Vectors
nodes.title: Persona Steering Vectors
nodes.description: Pre-computed vectors used to steer the language model's output towards specific persona traits or styles, influencing the generated text.

nodes.label: Gating Mechanism Logic
nodes.title: Gating Mechanism Logic
nodes.description: Logic responsible for evaluating and applying gates during chat interactions, potentially controlling model behavior or access to certain functionalities.

nodes.label: DND Playground Configuration
nodes.title: DND Playground Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration and data bundle from the DND playground, used to define specific interaction rules, traits, and parameters for gated chat scenarios.

nodes.label: Stream Gated Chat
nodes.title: Stream Gated Chat Response
nodes.description: Provides a streaming API endpoint for gated chat interactions, returning Server-Sent Events (SSE) for tokens, banners, and trace information in real-time.

nodes.label: Process Gated Chat
nodes.title: Process Gated Chat Request
nodes.description: Handles synchronous gated chat requests, applying gating logic and persona steering based on DND playground configurations to generate a single, complete response.

nodes.label: Generate Persona-Steered Chat
nodes.title: Generate Persona-Steered Chat
nodes.description: Generates a chat response steered by a specific persona vector and alpha value, allowing for controlled influence on the model's output based on user-defined traits.

nodes.label: Stream Persona-Steered Chat
nodes.title: Stream Persona-Steered Chat
nodes.description: Provides a streaming API endpoint for persona-steered chat, delivering real-time token generation influenced by persona vectors for dynamic interaction.

nodes.label: Generate Basic Chat
nodes.title: Generate Basic Chat Response
nodes.description: Handles synchronous basic chat requests, generating a response from the language model without advanced steering or gating mechanisms applied.

nodes.label: Stream Basic Chat
nodes.title: Stream Basic Chat Response
nodes.description: Provides a streaming API endpoint for basic chat, delivering real-time token generation from the language model for continuous output.

groups.label: API Endpoints
groups.title: User-Facing API Endpoints
groups.description: These components expose the primary chat functionalities as HTTP API endpoints for external consumption.

groups.label: Text Generation
groups.title: Text Generation Functions
groups.description: Components responsible for orchestrating the generation of chat responses, potentially with steering or gating applied.

groups.label: Analytical Logic
groups.title: Analytical Logic Components
groups.description: External components that perform analysis or decision-making, such as applying gating rules to chat interactions.

groups.label: Data Sources
groups.title: External Data Sources
groups.description: External data repositories or configurations that influence the behavior of the chat interfaces.
